mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, cash, margin, status, created_at, updated_at FROM accounts WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, cash, margin, status, created_at, updated_at FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (id, user_id, cash, margin, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{cash}, 1000000.0000), COALESCE(#{margin}, 0), 'ACTIVE')
